reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it walks viewers through joining Forsage BUSD, approving BUSD use, sending BUSD for registration, paying BNB network fees, and activating an account. The separately cited SEC complaint identifies Forsage's paid-slot and recruitment-dependent compensation mechanism. The video shows an instructional participation route; it does not itself display a guaranteed return or prove any completed payout.

opening.argument: The presentation includes a visible disclaimer before the registration flow, including risk-oriented and non-liability language, which is inconsistent with an unequivocal promise of safe or profitable participation. The speaker also describes the activity as a simulation rather than reporting a successful investment result. The supplied material therefore supports a cautious demonstration with disclosed risk, not deceptive certification of earnings.

citations.quote: this time I will simulate the registration process

rebuttal.rebuttal: The title and registration instructions establish the subject, but they do not establish that viewers were promised profits or that the creator concealed risk. The supplied material instead shows a disclaimer before acceptance and describes the activity as a simulation. Registration steps alone cannot convert a disclosed, risk-bearing demonstration into proof of a scam.

citations.quote: HOW TO REGISTER FORSAGE BUSD
this time I will simulate the registration process

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not change what the video is operationally enabling. The speaker still gives sequential instructions for registration, including wallet funding and confirmation steps. The warning shown on the page is not evidence that the speaker independently investigated the arrangement or that participants could avoid its financial risks.

citations.quote: make sure our wallets have an invoice, yes, then the bus BNB for the gas
click register then you will see an option here it is Ethereum, there is an ethernet there is a Tron

opening.argument: This is framed as an operational walkthrough: the speaker explicitly says he will simulate registration and narrates interface actions from opening the registration option through confirmation. The title identifies a how-to topic, and the narration focuses on following displayed steps rather than persuading viewers with testimonials, income claims, or a promised return. On the supplied evidence, the central purpose is instructional technology use.

citations.quote: HOW TO REGISTER FORSAGE BUSD
this time I will simulate the registration process
just follow the steps that are in the display

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video a tutorial does not make it ordinary education when the tutorial is specifically about joining Forsage BUSD. The title names registration, the narration directs the viewer to click Register, and the walkthrough ends by describing the process as successful. Those details show actionable participation guidance, not detached commentary.

citations.quote: HOW TO REGISTER FORSAGE BUSD
click register then you will see an option here it is Ethereum, there is an ethernet there is a Tron
it will succeed

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The instructional format is precisely what makes the content actionable. It does not merely explain blockchain concepts; it walks through authorization, account creation, and completion of the Forsage flow. The absence of an explicit earnings promise does not erase the practical encouragement created by showing viewers how to join.

citations.quote: step 2, click to register

opening.argument: The supplied record shows a digital registration service and a transaction workflow, but it does not show a guaranteed return, a claimed payout, or a request for credentials to be sent to the speaker. The wallet screen displays existing BNB and BUSD assets before the site is opened, while the registration interface identifies the BNB amount as a network-fee requirement. Those details are consistent with an ordinary user-controlled blockchain transaction, and the key scam mechanisms are not established by this video alone.

citations.quote: then the bus BNB for the gas

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a spoken guarantee does not resolve the central issue: the video directs a viewer through a paid registration process. It tells viewers to hold wallet assets, authorize BUSD, and complete account creation. Whether the wallet already contained assets or the transaction involved a network fee does not establish that the service is ordinary or financially safe.

citations.quote: make sure our wallets have an invoice, yes, then the bus BNB for the gas

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing elements identified by the defense are not required to show scam participation. The video visibly proceeds from BUSD authorization to sending BUSD for account registration and then displays activation success. That is stronger than a generic commerce example: it is a concrete route into the named Forsage system, while the fee label does not explain the broader economic arrangement.
